authors: Z. Bern, J.J.M. Carrasco, W.-M. Chen, A. Edison, H. Johansson, J. Parra-Martinez, R. Roiban, M. Zeng
title: Ultraviolet properties of N=8 supergravity at five loops
claim: With an integrand from the generalized double copy (built on the five-loop N=4 SYM integrand), the five-loop four-point N=8 supergravity amplitude first diverges in D_c=24/5 (D^8 R^4 counterterm); the divergence is a combination of two positive-definite vacuum-like integrals, excluding additional UV cancellations at this order.
scheme: Dimensional regularization around the critical dimension (vacuum-integral expansion and reduction); the abstract does not specify the scheme further.
symmetry_argument: Generalized double copy from 16-supercharge SYM numerators; no regulated-action SUSY argument.

proved: Leading UV behaviour of the constructed integrand in D=24/5 computed (abstract).
assumed: Correctness of the generalized-double-copy integrand in D dims (built on S1d.06_BCJR2012).

evidence: Abstract: D_c=24/5, D^8R^4 counterterm, two positive-definite integrals, relations to lower-loop integrals.
red_flags: Non-integer critical dimension; SUSY of the continuation inherited from the gauge-theory integrand, not from a regulator.
cross_checks: Contrasted with enhanced cancellations in N=4 (three loops) and N=5 (four loops) supergravity (S1d.09_BDD2014).
notes: Lead correct (id). Full text not read.
